summary: First Keystone Corporation filed an 8-K disclosing entry into Subordinated Note Purchase Agreements on September 30, 2026, issuing $32.5 million aggregate principal of 7.50% fixed-to-floating subordinated notes due September 30, 2036, at par, to institutional accredited investors and qualified institutional buyers in a private placement under Section 4(a)(2) and Rule 506(b). Interest is fixed at 7.50% until September 30, 2031, then Three-Month Term SOFR plus 277 basis points; notes rank subordinated and unsecured, count as Tier 2 capital, and are non-callable before September 30, 2031. Performance Trust Capital Partners acted as placement agent; proceeds for general corporate purposes. No special-situation event; routine capital issuance.
